coverageMatrix.completeness: Ceftriaxone covers the large majority of community-acquired pyelonephritis pathogens.
gaps: Enterococcus not covered by either regimen - add ampicillin if isolated on culture and blood cultures are positive.

stewardship.deescalation: Once urine/blood culture results return, narrow to the most targeted oral agent matching susceptibility, and complete the course orally once afebrile for 24-48 hours.
